system.description: You open every valve at once. Test Agility (DR16). On a success, everyone within 15' of the rig, except those aboard, takes d10 scalding damage, and the rig is wreathed in steam: it and everyone aboard have heavy cover until the start of your next turn.

outcomes.failure: Half damage, and light cover instead.
outcomes.ruin: The steam blows back into the cab: everyone aboard takes d6 damage.
